prompt:
Design a desktop website page, 16:9 landscape (1920x1080), showing the FIRST VIEWPORT and the top of the next section, rendered as the web page itself edge to edge (no browser window, no device frame, no mockup).

Brand: ROOMi (ROOMiVERSE), a DJ lifestyle brand: "any ordinary space becomes your party, anywhere, with anyone". This is the "Meet ROOMi" brand page. Attached: (1) the logo, a two-wordmark graffiti "ROOMi ROOMi"; (2) the designer's current Figma page for content and order (keep its CONTENT, not its layout).

VISUAL WORLD (the site's system): the whole site is art-directed as a mini CD single release package — jewel case, OBI paper strip, screen-printed disc, lyric/liner-note booklet — crossed with the restraint of minimal Korean fashion sites (Gentle Monster, Ader Error): generous white/light-gray #F0F0F0 paper, small precise grotesk type, big confident display moments. Brand colors as print inks: hot pink #F71D64, violet #C14ED4, peach #FFB792, deep black #111111. The graffiti logo and one hand-sprayed black X mark are the only hand-made marks.

Top navigation (same on every page): thin bar, logo at the exact center, left "MEET ROOMi" (active), "WHAT'S GOING ON", "LET'S PARTY", "SHOP"; right "CART (0)", "MY". Small uppercase grotesk.

Real copy to use:
- BRAND STORY: "For those who love DJing but have been held back by the barriers of equipment, ROOMi offers an experience where anyone can become an artist. ROOMi empowers anyone, anywhere, to freely create a space that reflects their own musical universe."
- ABOUT US: "Our mission is to lower the barriers to DJing and make it easier for anyone to play, share, and enjoy music anywhere, with anyone."
- Values: "Play — Touch it. Try it. Make it yours." / "Immersion — Less setup. More music." / "Expansion — Start small. Make it bigger."
- Sections in order: Brand Story, About Us, Value, How.
No prices, no fake stats, no testimonials.

Composition: the first viewport is a fold-out poster insert being opened: the screen is divided by visible fold creases into a 4-panel grid (slight paper relief and shadow along the creases). The largest panel holds the flash-lit concert crowd photo with the gradient two-wordmark logo; the next panel holds "BRAND STORY" and the text in grotesk on light gray paper; a narrow panel holds a vertical OBI-like strip in hot pink with "MEET ROOMi" and the tracklist "01 Brand Story / 02 About Us / 03 Value / 04 How". Below the fold, the next section begins with a huge hot-pink "ABOUT US".

One dominant move per viewport; everything else holds still in the paper and ink. Body text near 16px at this size.
